tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Attested copies of documents indicating provided services of outsource manpower to the Government/Semi Government Departments and mimimumum Rs.6.5 lakhs work done certificate to be enclosed (from minimum 2 institutions)
Name of the Contractor and Firms full Address (Attach Letter head) Office Phone, Fax, and Mobile No and E-mail ID
Whether the firm Owned or proprietorship or partnership
Registration Certificate under Shops & Commercial Establishment Act (The Firm Should enclose Current Years Certified valid Certificate)
E P F Registration Certificate, last months challan and NDC to be enclosed (Attested Copy)
E S I Registration Certificate last months challan and NDC to be enclosed (Attested Copy)
Submission of GST paid record from year 2023-24 , 2024-25 & 2025-26
Submission of income tax paid record from year 2023-24 , 2024-25 & 2025-26
Submission of self-declaration letter in the form of Annexure (A) on the firms letter head.
Attach declaration by Notary, If the disbursal of Amount is delayed by Government, the firm should certify that they will pay the salaries to its employees within 5th of the Month.
2.5% of the total tender amount as security deposit ie Enclosing declaration letter (Annexure-B)
Balance sheet of minimum 39 Lakh annual turnover with UDIN number certified by a Chartered Accountant for the last three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26
